feedback.summary: The resume has a relevant skill set but lacks depth in the experience section. The overall score is low due to missing key sections and insufficient detail.

feedback.experience_feedback: The experience section is brief and lacks detail. It would be beneficial to include specific projects, metrics (e.g., user base growth), and any leadership roles to demonstrate the impact of your work.
